notice: All destinations, prices, capacities, funding amounts, and availability shown by this prototype are planning examples. They are not active offers, medical treatment, legal tender, or guaranteed benefits.

destinations.name: Florida Coast Trial Stay
destinations.summary: A voluntary short stay used to test climate, transportation, accessibility, medical access, community fit, and daily support before any permanent move.

destinations.name: Mountain Renewal Trial Stay
destinations.region: Colorado, Montana, or another chosen mountain community
destinations.summary: A voluntary trial stay for people who prefer mountain air, smaller communities, outdoor recreation, or a different pace of life.

destinations.name: Supported Coastal Move
destinations.summary: A person-directed relocation package that can coordinate housing, transportation, furnishings, benefits navigation, local care, and follow-up support.

destinations.name: Supported Mountain Move
destinations.region: Chosen mountain or nearby plains community
destinations.summary: A voluntary relocation package for people who select a mountain region or an accessible nearby community after reviewing climate, services, cost, and transportation.

destinations.name: Sail and See
destinations.summary: A supported vacation package that may include adaptive sailing, coastal sightseeing, accessible lodging, and an attendant or companion chosen by the traveler.

homes.name: BeeNest Studio
homes.assembly: Panelized snap-together shell with inspected mechanical connections
homes.summary: A compact permanent or transitional home designed around one resident's chosen accessibility and support technology.

homes.name: CareNest One
homes.assembly: Factory-built modules joined on a permitted foundation
homes.summary: A private one-bedroom home with room for visiting care, adaptive equipment, and a flexible support station without making the residence feel institutional.

homes.name: HiveLink Duplex
homes.type: Two private homes with an optional shared support core
homes.assembly: Repeatable structural bays with replaceable utility cartridges
homes.summary: Two independent residences that can share backup power, transportation staging, laundry, or staff space while preserving privacy.

homes.name: Honeycomb Courtyard
homes.assembly: Standardized home modules around a shaded accessible courtyard
homes.summary: A small community of private homes with optional nurses, coordinators, transportation, workshops, recreation, and shared meals.

benefitUnits.label: Stay Night
benefitUnits.description: One approved night in listed lodging.

benefitUnits.label: Accessible Ride
benefitUnits.description: One scheduled local or transfer ride within package rules.

benefitUnits.label: Meal
benefitUnits.description: One approved meal or grocery allocation.

benefitUnits.label: Support Hour
benefitUnits.description: One hour of approved non-emergency support or coordination.

benefitUnits.label: Experience
benefitUnits.description: One listed recreational or cultural activity.

benefitUnits.label: Move Package
benefitUnits.description: One approved move plan with defined scope and limits.

benefitUnits.label: Home Setup
benefitUnits.description: One approved furnishing, utility, and accessibility setup package.
